source.publisher: Western Australia Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
source.title: Works approval W6964/2024/1 — BioIron Pilot Plant Project

observations: Western Australia's regulator records works approval W6964/2024/1 for Hamersley Iron Pty Limited (trading as Rio Tinto Limited) for the BioIron Pilot Plant Project at East Rockingham.
The regulated activity is Category 44 — metal smelting or refining.
limits: Regulatory approval establishes an authorised pilot-plant pathway and regulatory identity, not commercial-scale technical success, economics, production contribution, emissions performance, or an Alpha score.
methodology: source-only; no scoring, underwriting, adjudication, or canonical promotion
